<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Light Lionfish 40</title>
<style>
/* Light Lionfish 40 by andrew-demchenk0 — https://uiverse.io/andrew-demchenk0/light-lionfish-40 */
.container input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 0;
  width: 0;
}

.container {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}

.container svg {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 50px;
  width: 50px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  fill: #666;
}

.container svg:hover {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.container input:checked ~ svg {
  fill: #ffeb49;
}
</style>
</head>
